entries.zh: 性情怯懦胆小；品性不良、懦弱怕事
entries.notes: 中间字「壺」与两栏音写难以字面对应且 M 栏第三音 T99 污损，据「性…怯」与西语 condiçion mala 定怯懦义

entries.zh: 性偏（徧）：性情偏邪、心术不正，生性倾向坏的一面
entries.en: ill-inclined; of a biased, crooked disposition

entries.zh: 牛马心性：兽性般的性情，粗野愚顽、缺乏人性
entries.en: beastly disposition; a brutish nature like that of oxen and horses

entries.zh: 性情：脾气、品性；西语标 buena，谓性情良好
entries.notes: 西语 condiçion buena 带「良」之限定而汉字栏仅中性「性情」，限定词未入汉字栏，照四栏实况对译

entries.zh: 性行好：天性善良、品行端正
entries.en: good disposition; good in nature and conduct

entries.zh: 同气：性情相合、脾气投契（与另一人性情相配）；亦指同胞骨肉（同气连枝）
entries.en: of like temperament, congenial with another; also siblings of the same blood

entries.zh: 沛賴（闽南记音字）：性情凶悍蛮横、粗暴无礼
entries.en: bad and savage disposition; fierce, unruly (characters used phonetically)
entries.notes: 「沛賴」非字面义，为闽南口语记音，凶恶义主要据西语 condiçion malaferoz 推定

entries.zh: 窗下：同学、同窗（谓同窗共读，「窗下」为「同窗」之省）
entries.en: fellow student, classmate (lit. 'under the window', elliptical for 同窗 'same window')
entries.notes: 「窗下」对译 condiscípulo 系由「同窗」取义的省略式推断，非字面直译

entries.zh: 窗友：同窗、同学、同窗之友
伴读：陪读之人、学伴（陪伴他人一同读书）
entries.en: study companion; one who accompanies another in study

entries.zh: 解：解罪、告解（向神父认罪）；兼有解开、解释之义
entries.en: to confess (sins, sacramental confession); to untie, explain
entries.notes: 官话栏两音节均污损（T99），据西语词头 Confessar 及本页第 17 条「解罪」定告解义

entries.zh: 认：承认、认罪；亦指认债（承认所欠债务）
entries.en: to acknowledge, admit, confess (a sin); also to acknowledge a debt

entries.zh: 供：招供、供认（受审时招承其事）；兼有供给之义
entries.en: to confess, own up (in interrogation); also to supply

entries.zh: 认罪、认错：招认自己做下的恶行
entries.en: to confess the wrong one has done; to own up to a misdeed
entries.notes: 汉字栏作「識」而音写与之不对应，疑有讹误，「认恶行」义主要据西语 confesar el mal hecho 推定

entries.zh: 禳：禳解、禳祭（祭祷以禳除灾邪；西语语境近于向偶像祭祷）
entries.en: to perform propitiatory or exorcistic rites to avert evil (Spanish damaged, likely referring to idols)
entries.notes: 西语尾部「?doto」疑为 ídolo 之污损、M 栏 T99 污损，据清晰的汉字「禳」定祭禳义

entries.zh: 解罪：（天主教）告解，向神父认罪以消罪
entries.en: to confess one's sins (sacramental confession); to have sins absolved

entries.zh: 食罪：自领其罪、认罪担过（字面「吃罪」，谓把罪过认下承担）
entries.en: to own one's sins, take the blame upon oneself (lit. 'eat sin'); confess one's faults
entries.notes: 「食罪」为闽南俗语式表达（字面「吃罪」），与西语「认己罪」的对应照封存件四栏对译
